notes.title: Rugösi gets a major overhaul
notes.content: [p]This overhaul includes;[/p][list][*][p]Transition to a new game engine and enabling smoother gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Much better collisions and movement.[/p][/*][*][p]New challenging levels.[/p][/*][*][p]2 new characters.[/p][/*][*][p]Occasions where you can make choices.[/p][/*][*][p]Steam leaderboards to compete against others.[/p][/*][*][p]2 new languages: German and Turkish.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: New update
notes.content: Rugosi has received a major update that includes a lighting system to make the game experience much better. Also, a button to turn music on/off has been added.
